model: DULCOMETER AEGIS II controller (Modbus RTU slave)
applies_to: AEGIS II controllers fitted with the COM module (Modbus RTU slave on XB21/XB22), per manual BA DM 229 08/18.
summary: The AEGIS II is a ProMinent DULCOMETER controller. Its COM module, fitted in module slot 3, adds a read-only Modbus RTU slave port on RS-485. Every 32-bit value is published twice, once low word first and once high word first; this map uses the high-word-first copy (registers 901-1123) and covers the input readings A-Z, relay and pulse outputs, alarm levels, totalisers, on/off setpoints and the input, output and system state words.

addressing.note: Each row gives a decimal 'Register' and its PDU address; the PDU address is the register minus 1 (ProMinent register 100 is fetched at PDU 99). Here 'address' is the PDU address, e.g. input A in the high-word-first block is register 901, PDU 900.

source.title: Software manual DULCOMETER Controller AEGIS II Modbus RTU
source.pages: pp. 5-6 (bus settings and defaults), p. 10 (commands, word order, numbering), pp. 11-17 (register table), pp. 18-20 (state bits)

notes: The manual publishes each 32-bit value twice: registers 501-723 carry bits 15-0 in the first register (low word first, CDAB) and registers 901-1123 carry bits 31-16 first (ABCD). Only the ABCD copy is listed; the CDAB copy is the same layout 400 registers lower.
16-bit state registers for inputs A-Z also appear in both blocks (679-704 and 1079-1104).
All values are read-only; any write, or a read of an unlisted register, returns an exception. The manual asks for no more than one query per second.
Readings are floats in the user units configured for each input; the manual gives no units.
Left out: the P7 control-state row, whose printed PDU address (1110) clashes with R4 while its register is 1117; PDU 1116 is likely but not stated.
Inputs K-N, W-Z and the 'phantom' values depend on the AEGIS II configuration and plug-in modules.

registers.name: System state
registers.description: Common controller state word.

bits.1: Restart after software reset (watchdog, Ethernet, user)
bits.16: No Wi-Fi module response at power-on
bits.26: All digital inputs set to contact sets (manufacturing)
bits.29: No fan: inputs powered down, outputs off

integration.summary: Poll holding registers (function 03) in the 901-1123 block, at most once per second. Inputs A-N are the sensor readings as high-word-first floats; the state words tell you whether each input and output is enabled, alarmed or interlocked.
integration.enable: Fit the COM module in module slot 3 and set the slave address, baud rate and parity at MENU > System > Communications. Connect the master to XB21/XB22 (the XB1 port is the module's own master port for a Pyxis ST-500 probe).
quirks: Two copies of every value: 501-723 low word first, 901-1123 high word first. Pick one and stay with it.
Register numbers are 1-based; subtract 1 for the PDU address.
setup: Defaults: slave address 10, 19200 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.
Termination for the slave port is set with jumper XT2 on the COM module.
With no parity, 2 stop bits are required.
gotchas: Poll no faster than once per second.
Disabled inputs, alarms and outputs read 0 rather than an error.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
